description: List the actions held for approval in your workspace, newest first: what was asked, who asked (agent or key), its status (pending, approved, rejected or expired) and when it expires. status pending lists what waits for a decision; pass its id to decide_approval. Needs a Last Price credential with audit read scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

limit.description: Most approvals to return. Defaults to 50.

status.description: Only approvals with this status, e.g. pending.

name: list_approvals
